stress_protocol.exposure_transition: index modulo 30: 0-9 unchanged, 10-19 gain 0.35, 20-29 gain 1.6 plus 20
stress_protocol.depth_dropout: index modulo 30 in 10-12: all optical-Z samples NaN
stress_protocol.rgb_dropout: index modulo 30 equals 10: all RGB samples zero
stress_protocol.exposure_space: display-referred uint8 RGB; not a physical camera, sunlight or sensor noise model
stress_protocol.initial_preview: unperturbed for all variants; one identical seed, no automatic reseeding
